raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The payments-source feed renamed status POSTED to SETTLED on 2026-01-16, and batches 12-14 (ingested 2026-01-17 onward) carry only SETTLED or REVERSED. silver_transactions filters on status = 'POSTED', so every row from those batches is dropped. Since the rename is documented as meaning-preserving, SETTLED should be treated as equivalent to POSTED, with REVERSED still excluded as before.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status IN ('POSTED', 'SETTLED');"}}
